notes.title: Summer Sale and Giant Beach Balls
notes.content:
Celebrate your summer with a new giant beach ball hat! (and a 50% discount for your friends).

v1.3.5.3 Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added a giant beach ball hat (it's huge)
[/list]

notes.title: Lucky Hat Now Available
notes.content:
Happy Saint Patricks Day!

Celebrate the season with a lucky pot of gold. These things aren't cheap, so we had to pull some strings with the leprechauns to get them in the shop.

Hit the greens with the new "Lucky Hat". Will it improve your score card? Probably! I mean, just look at the size of that thing!

v1.3.5 Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Lucky Hat to the shop
[*] Captured multiple leprechauns
[*] Took lots of naps
[/list]
